page.overview:
Who is Basil Hawkins?

Basil Hawkins is an infamous pirate from North Blue known as the "Magician" and the captain of the Hawkins Pirates. He is one of twelve pirates who are referred to as the "Worst Generation". Hawkins attempted to create a Pirate Alliance with Eustass Kid and Scratchmen Apoo but he was betrayed by the latter who had secretly become a subordinate of the Emperor Kaidou. Defeated by Kaidou, Hawkins joined the Beasts Pirates and became one of the crew's Shinuchi.

His previous known bounty amounted to 249,000,000, but after the timeskip, it was raised to 320,000,000.

Due to his actions and role, he is a supporting antagonist in the Wano Country Arc.

Hawkins is a tall man with a pair of three thin black triangle symbols on his eyebrows, red eyes, and golden-blonde hair that reaches down to his hips. He also has a black tattooed at the base of his throat.
